classification.difficultyReason: Recover totals from averages and calculate missing, combined and updated values.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The average of 7 numbers is 36. An eighth number is chosen so that the average is now 45. What is the eighth number?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Original total}&=7\times36\\\text{Original total}&=252\\\text{New total}&=8\times45\\\text{New total}&=360\\\text{Eighth number}&=360-252\\\text{Eighth number}&=108\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: The average of 7 numbers is 17 and the average of four of them is 14. What is the average of the other three numbers?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Total of seven}&=7\times17\\\text{Total of seven}&=119\\\text{Total of four}&=4\times14\\\text{Total of four}&=56\\\text{Other average}&=(119-56)\div3\\\text{Other average}&=21\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: The average of 6 numbers is 29 and the average of four other numbers is 44. What is the average of the 10 numbers?

children.label: d
children.prompt: A batsman had an average of 38 runs for 5 innings. If he scored 62 in his next innings, what was then his average?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{New average}&=(5\times38+62)\div6\\\text{New average}&=(190+62)\div6\\\text{New average}&=252\div6\\\text{New average}&=42\end{align*}$$

His average was 42 runs per innings.
